# lab series

```text
Summarize repeated runs of one setup (MLflow tag "series"): count, average, lowest, highest, spread.
  lab series            every series
  lab series marvin     only series whose name contains "marvin"
Start a series: SERIES=<name> lab quality <model> "<note>" --full --seed 1 (same name for every repeat).
Read-only. Good result: one block per series; if the gap between two settings is smaller than the spread
of their own repeats, treat them as the same.
```

Usage:

```
lab series [filter]
```
